check-requests.caption: Enter your name and phone, choose Reimbursement, and enter the payee.
Pick your committee, enter your Zelle email or cellphone, and say what the expenses were for.
Enter the date, amount requested, and receipt total, then attach the paid receipt.
On the review step, enter your cellphone number and tap Text me a code.
Check both confirmation boxes, then tap Submit request.
Past requests shows where each request stands.
A request marked Changes requested has an Update & resubmit button.
Tap a receipt to see it full size.

rcap-capsule.caption: Tap Sign in, enter your mobile number, and tap Text me a code.
The first time in, add the name families will see, pick your house, and add your student.
Tap the album name at the top right to switch events.
The download icon opens Save to Photos, or Download file on a computer.
Tap Add photos, choose photos or videos from your camera roll, then tap Add 5 files to the Capsule.
Tap any photo to open it. Share and download are at the top; tap Thank you, that's my kid! to thank the parent privately.
Tap Invite to copy the album link or a ready-made message for your group chat.
Thank-yous from other families land privately in My Capsule.

carpool.caption: Tap Continue with Google, or fill in your name, your child, and a spot near you, then pick it from the suggestions.
Choose Morning drop-off and your days, add your phone and email, then tap Continue.
Enter the 6-digit code from your email and tap Verify my code.
Your family is saved. A committee admin approves you before other families appear.
Once approved, Explore nearby families shows each family's area, distance, and the ride times you share.
Open Your account to edit your family or change how far out families show up.
Under Groups near you, tick the sharing box, then tap Request to join.
Once the organizer accepts, you see every family in the group and how to reach them.
Tap Start our group text to plan drivers, a pickup time, and a spot together.

uniform-exchange.caption: Say who it's for, choose your house, then pick the item and size and tap Add to my request.
Enter your name, your student and grade, and a cell we can text, then tap Send my request.
Student to student is the default: your bin holder's student brings it to yours at school. Not ready? Tap Decide later.
Your private My requests page shows each item's status. Tap Got it once it's in your hands.
Lost your link? Open My requests, enter your cell and tap Text me my link.
Tap "I have clothes to donate", say what you have, and tap Offer it up. Your bin holder arranges the pickup.
